pages.title: Dobby Peeking Through the Garden Hedge at Number Four Privet Drive Coloring Page
pages.description: Dobby peeks through the garden hedge at Number Four Privet Drive in this printable coloring page, with large leaves framing his face and long ears. His hands part the foliage beside a path leading to the front door. The coloring sheet combines broad clothing areas with smaller leaf shapes, window panes, and roof tiles.

pages.title: Dobby Levitating Aunt Petunia's Decorated Pudding in the Dursleys' Kitchen Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dobby levitating Aunt Petunia's decorated pudding in the Dursleys' kitchen while she raises her hands beneath the floating dessert. Holly leaves top the pudding, and flowers cover Petunia's apron. Cabinets, a curtained window, and a checked tablecloth add straight lines and repeating patterns to the coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dobby Bewitching a Bludger Beside the Hogwarts Quidditch Stands Coloring Page
pages.description: Dobby reaches toward a hovering Bludger beside the Hogwarts Quidditch stands in this printable coloring page, with motion lines curving around the large ball. Three goal hoops rise behind him between flag-topped towers. His loose garment offers open coloring areas, while the stands, distant castle, and ball bands give the coloring sheet smaller sections.

pages.title: Dobby Discussing His Wages with Albus Dumbledore in the Headmaster's Office Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Dobby discussing his wages with Albus Dumbledore in the headmaster's office, holding a small pouch beside the seated wizard. Books, an owl, and a globe fill the space behind them. Dumbledore's long beard and patterned robe trim contrast with Dobby's plain clothing on this detailed coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dobby Wearing His Badge-covered Tea-cosy Hat, Horseshoe Tie, Football Shorts, and Mismatched Socks Coloring Page
pages.description: Dobby wears his badge-covered tea-cosy hat, horseshoe tie, football shorts, and mismatched socks in this printable coloring page, smiling while holding his long patterned tie. One sock has stripes and the other has spots. The uncluttered coloring sheet leaves plenty of open space around his figure, with smaller shapes in the hat decorations and clothing patterns.

pages.title: Dobby Proudly Showing His First Earned Galleon to Winky in the Hogwarts Kitchens Coloring Page
pages.description: Dobby proudly shows his first earned Galleon to Winky in the Hogwarts kitchens in this printable coloring page, raising the coin beside her clasped hands. Hanging utensils, stacked pots, and a stone arch surround the two elves. Their large ears and draped clothes provide broad shapes, while the coin and kitchen equipment add smaller coloring details.

pages.title: Dobby Comforting Winky Beside the Hogwarts Kitchen Fireplace Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dobby comforting Winky beside the Hogwarts kitchen fireplace, resting one hand on her cap while holding her other hand. Winky sits on the hearth with a cloth against her cheek. Flames, a hanging cooking pot, and shelves of utensils frame the pair, adding background sections to this Harry Potter coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dobby Carrying a Tray of Chocolate Eclairs Through the Hogwarts Kitchen Doorway Coloring Page
pages.description: Dobby carries a tray of chocolate eclairs through the Hogwarts kitchen doorway in this printable coloring page, stepping forward beneath a pointed stone arch. Rows of iced pastries fill the tray between his hands. The open door, ring handle, hanging pans, and flagstone floor give this coloring sheet a mix of narrow details and larger spaces.

pages.title: Dobby Magically Sending a Feast From the Hogwarts Kitchen Tables to the Great Hall Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dobby magically sending a feast from the Hogwarts kitchen tables to the Great Hall, guiding floating platters with raised hands. Roast dishes, fruit, pies, and a cake travel overhead among sparkles. Long tables, benches, tall windows, and candles extend the scene, giving this coloring sheet many separate food and architectural details.

pages.title: Dobby Washing Copper Cooking Pots Beside the Hogwarts Kitchen Sink Coloring Page
pages.description: Dobby washes copper cooking pots beside the Hogwarts kitchen sink in this printable coloring page, scrubbing a large pot beneath a running tap and bubbles. More pots stand nearby, with pans hanging on the wall. The coloring sheet includes rounded cookware, diamond window panes, and stone blocks around the elf's loose, ragged garment.

pages.title: Dobby Lighting the Fireplace in the Empty Gryffindor Common Room Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Dobby lighting the fireplace in the empty Gryffindor common room, holding kindling and a small flame beside the stacked logs. A lion banner hangs near the window, and another lion decorates the rug beneath him. The broad hearth stones and armchair contrast with the finer woodgrain and patterned borders on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dobby Wearing a Santa Hat and Carrying Cocoa and Cookies Beside a Christmas Tree Coloring Page
pages.description: Dobby wears a Santa hat and carries cocoa and cookies beside a Christmas tree in this printable coloring page, holding a steaming mug and plate. Marshmallows top the drink, while stars, round ornaments, and bead garlands decorate the tree. Wrapped presents and bows add smaller enclosed shapes around the elf on this festive coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dobby Tickling the Pear in the Fruit Portrait to Open the Hogwarts Kitchen Entrance Coloring Page
pages.description: Dobby tickles the pear in the fruit portrait to open the Hogwarts kitchen entrance in this printable coloring page, touching the smiling fruit's cheek. The ornate frame swings aside to reveal hanging pans and shelves of pots. Grapes, leaves, curling frame decorations, and large stone blocks give this Harry Potter coloring sheet varied shapes to fill.

pages.title: Dobby Retrieving Gillyweed From a Jar in Severus Snape's Storage Cupboard Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dobby retrieving gillyweed from a jar in Severus Snape's storage cupboard, lifting long leafy strands from the open container. Bottles and jars line the shelves around him, with a lantern, barrel, and chest nearby. The tangled plant shapes add fine details beside his broad clothing areas on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dobby Pointing Out the Room of Requirement Opposite the Dancing Troll Tapestry Coloring Page
pages.description: Dobby points out the Room of Requirement opposite the dancing troll tapestry in this printable coloring page, extending one arm toward a tall arched door. The tapestry shows a troll lifting one foot among repeated decorative motifs. Curved woodgrain, Gothic arches, columns, and floor tiles surround the elf, creating a detailed Hogwarts corridor coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dobby Settling Winky Into an Elf-sized Bed Inside the Room of Requirement Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page features Dobby settling Winky into an elf-sized bed inside the Room of Requirement, drawing the blanket up around her small figure. Winky looks toward him from her pillow beneath a frilled cap. Round bedpost tops, tall wall arches, a chest, and stacked furniture frame the broad bedding shapes on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dobby Listening to Aberforth Dumbledore Beside the Two-way Mirror at the Hog's Head Inn Coloring Page
pages.description: Dobby listens to Aberforth Dumbledore beside the two-way mirror at the Hog's Head Inn in this printable coloring page, standing with his hands held together. Aberforth leans forward on his chair and gestures beside a small table. His long tied beard, the mirror frame, a barrel, and wooden floorboards add contrasting details to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dobby Appearing Beside Luna Lovegood in the Malfoy Manor Cellar Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page shows Dobby appearing beside Luna Lovegood in the Malfoy Manor cellar, with curling magical lines and sparkles surrounding the small elf. Luna wears a jacket over a skirt patterned with stars, moons, and an animal figure. Barrels, bottles, stone walls, and steps complete the setting around the pair on this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dobby Using Wandless Magic to Loosen the Chandelier Above the Malfoy Manor Drawing Room Coloring Page
pages.description: Dobby uses wandless magic to loosen the chandelier above the Malfoy Manor drawing room in this printable coloring page, reaching upward beneath its curved arms. Motion lines circle the hanging fixture and its candles. Tall curtains, wall panels, an upholstered chair, and a decorative vase furnish the room, adding large background sections to this coloring sheet.

pages.title: Dobby Magically Pulling Narcissa Malfoy's Wand From Her Hand in the Manor Doorway Coloring Page
pages.description: This printable coloring page depicts Dobby magically pulling Narcissa Malfoy's wand from her hand in the manor doorway, with the wand floating between their outstretched hands. Narcissa's long robe has curling patterns along its borders and sleeves. The open doors and tiled floor frame the figures, while Dobby's ragged clothing adds irregular outlines to the coloring sheet.
